title: Automate Product Demo Polish With MCP: Zooms, LUTs, Layouts, and Sharing From One Prompt
summary: Connect Claude, ChatGPT, or any MCP client to Tella and have an AI agent polish a raw screen recording: cut filler words and silences, generate zooms and layouts, grade the camera, check frames, and share or publish the video.
body_markdown:
An AI agent can take a raw Tella recording to a finished product demo. Connect Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, or any MCP client to Tella's[MCP server](https://www.tella.com/mcp) at` https://api.tella.com/mcp` , then ask: "Polish my latest demo: cut filler words and silences, add zooms, use product-demo layouts, warm up the camera, and make the link public." The agent cuts with` remove_fillers` and` remove_silences` , zooms with` generate_auto_zooms` , lays out screen and camera with` generate_auto_layouts` , grades with` set_clip_filters` , checks frames with` get_clip_frame` , and shares with` update_video` .


[Apply LUTs via MCP](https://www.tella.com/blog/apply-luts-with-mcp-ai-agent-color-grade) covers color on its own. This post covers the whole pass.


## What can the agent do?


Everything in a typical polish pass has a tool:


Step Tool What it does


Find the video` list_videos` ,` search_videos` ,` list_clips` Finds the recording and its clips


Read it` get_transcript` ,` understand_video` Reads what you said and asks a vision model what happens on screen


Cut` remove_fillers` ,` remove_silences` ,` cut_clip_by_transcript` Removes "um"s, pauses, and false starts


Zoom` generate_auto_zooms` ,` add_zoom` Zooms from recorded clicks, or one zoom on a spot


Lay out` generate_auto_layouts` ,` update_layout` ,` add_layout` Screen and camera arrangement, camera shape, Pop-out, b-roll


Color` set_clip_filters` Presets, sliders, and LUTs on the camera and screen


Finish` update_video` Title, Studio Sound, motion blur, camera shrink during zooms, link access


Check` get_clip_frame` ,` get_clip_preview` A rendered frame or short MP4 of the result


Deliver` export_video` ,` publish_to_social` An MP4 in up to 4K, or a post on YouTube, LinkedIn, X, and more


For two or more timeline edits at once (zooms, layouts, text, blurs),` apply_video_edits` batches up to 200 operations into one editor change.


## How do you connect an agent?


- **Claude:** add[Tella from Claude's connector directory](https://claude.ai/directory/tella) , or add a custom connector with` https://api.tella.com/mcp` .
- **ChatGPT:** open Tella in ChatGPT's apps.
- **Claude Code, Cursor, and other clients:** add a remote MCP server at` https://api.tella.com/mcp` and sign in with your Tella account.


The[MCP server docs](https://www.tella.com/docs/mcp-server) cover each client.


## A full polish, step by step


This is what a good agent does with "polish my latest demo." You can also ask for each step separately.


### 1. Cut


` remove_fillers` and` remove_silences` run per clip, like the editor's tools. For a restart ("let me try that again"), the agent reads` get_transcript` and cuts the flubbed take with` cut_clip_by_transcript` . Cut first, because zooms and layouts are timed to what's left.


### 2. Zoom


` generate_auto_zooms` places tracking zooms on the clicks in each clip's screen recording, the same as **Generate zooms** in the editor.` intensity` is` slow` (fewer, longer zooms),` medium` (the default), or` fast` (shorter, tighter, deeper), and` scale` overrides the magnification up to 3.5. It replaces earlier generated zooms unless you pass` replaceExisting: false` , and never touches manual zooms.


Prompt: "Add medium zooms to every clip, but no zoom in the first 5 seconds."


### 3. Lay out


` generate_auto_layouts` has AI watch the clip and choose layouts, like the editor's **Auto layouts** . Pick a` style` such as` product-demo-round` ,` product-demo-square` ,` product-demo-wide` ,` tutorial-round` , or` intro-and-outro` , and add` instructions` like "keep the camera visible the whole time" or "punch in whenever a menu opens."


To set the camera frame yourself,` update_layout` switches a camera bubble between` circle` ,` square` ,` landscape` , and` portrait` , and` popOut` turns on[Pop-out](https://www.tella.com/help/editing/create-a-pop-out-camera-effect) . For the[Blob camera](https://www.tella.com/blog/blob-camera-for-product-demos) , the agent writes a custom layout with` shape: "blob"` (or` "blob-outline"` ) on the camera slot.


### 4. Grade


` set_clip_filters` sets the camera and screen filters on a clip, for example:


```text
{
"videoId": "vid_…",
"clipId": "clip_…",
"camera": { "preset": "warm", "lut": { "id": "lut_portra", "intensity": 0.4 } },
"screen": { "preset": "crisp" }
}


```


Filters are per clip over MCP, so the agent calls it for each clip from` list_clips` . Keep the screen at` crisp` or` none` so your product's colors stay accurate.


### 5. Finish


` update_video` sets the title and description, turns on` studioSound` ,` motionBlur` , and` shrinkCameraDuringZooms` , and sets` linkScope` to` public` ,` private` ,` password` , or` embedonly` .


### 6. Check


After each step, the agent calls` get_clip_frame` at a few moments and looks. Vision-capable models catch what you would: a zoom on empty space, a layout that covers the UI, orange skin from a LUT at full strength. Ask for it: "After each change, show me a frame and fix anything that looks off."


### 7. Deliver


The share link is ready as soon as the edits are done; there's no render step. For a file,` export_video` returns a download in up to 4K. To post,` publish_to_social` uploads to YouTube, YouTube Shorts, LinkedIn, X, TikTok, Instagram, or Facebook under your[connected accounts](https://www.tella.com/help/sharing/publish-to-social-media) .


## Prompts that work


- "Polish *Q4 launch demo* : remove fillers and silences, add medium zooms, product-demo-round layouts, Warm on the camera, Crisp on the screen. Show me three frames when you're done."
- "For every video in the *Onboarding* playlist, apply our team LUT at 50% to the camera and turn on Studio Sound."
- "Use the Blob camera in the first 10 seconds of this video and a circle afterwards."
- "Find the part where I open Settings and punch in on it."
- "Make the link public, then publish to LinkedIn with the video's title. Ask me before posting."


## Keep a human in the loop


Every agent edit is an ordinary edit in the Tella editor, so you can open the video and adjust a zoom, a layout, or a filter by hand. Two habits help:


- **Ask for frames.** A frame per clip catches most problems before anyone else sees them.
- **Confirm before anything public.** Changing` linkScope` to` public` or calling` publish_to_social` shares the video. Tell the agent to ask first.
